description: This file is a centralized configuration module for the LMS Frontend in a React project. It reads environment variables, validates and processes feature flags, provides configuration constants, and exposes utility functions for constructing API URLs and retrieving base API URLs.

methods.name: parseFeatureFlags
methods.description: Parses feature flag definitions from environment variables, accepting JSON objects, arrays, or comma-separated strings, and returns a normalized object mapping flag names to booleans.

methods.name: getApiBase()
methods.description: Returns the base API URL, preferring the REACT_APP_API_BASE environment variable, falling back to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

methods.name: apiUrl(path = "")
methods.description: Constructs a full API URL by appending a path segment to the base API URL, ensuring proper slash usage.
